body.content:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for approving the temporary POD storage.

All tenant-side work required for the Certificate of Occupancy is scheduled to
be completed by this Tuesday. After that, the remaining dependency for our
final inspection will be completion of the exterior stair work and the City’s
approval of that work under the landlord’s separate permit.

We plan to request our final inspection for the next available date
immediately after the stair inspection passes. Please keep us updated on the
anticipated installation and inspection dates.

Thanks,  
Bharath

* * *

**From:** ALEX JO <ALEX@nwprime.com>  
**Sent:** Friday, October 16, 2026 2:25 PM  
**To:** Bharath Mysore <bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com>  
**Subject:** Re: Revised Plan

We can schedule the separate inspection for the exterior stairs as soon as
work at our job site is complete. I will work to expedite production as much
as possible.  
  
Best regards,  
  
Alex Jo  
NW Prime Properties, Inc.
